an3.98:1.1: aṅganteva saṅkhayaṁ → aṅgantveva saṅkhaṁ (bj, sya-all) | bhadro assājānīyo → bhaddo assājāniyo (sya-all) | bhadro → bhaddo (pts)
an3.98:1.3: bhadro assājānīyo → bhaddo assājāniyo (sya-all) | bhadro → bhaddo (pts)
an3.98:1.4: aṅganteva saṅkhyaṁ → aṅganttheva saṅkhaṁ (bj); aṅgantveva saṁkhaṁ (sya-all) | tīhi aṅgehi → tīhaṅgehi (sya-all) | bhadro assājānīyo → bhaddo assājāniyo (sya-all) | bhadro → bhaddo (pts)
an3.98:1.5: evamevaṁ kho → evam eva (pts) | lokassa → lokassā ti (pts)
an3.98:4.4: lokassāti sattamaṁ → lokassā ti navo pi (pts)
